body.html: Home / Privacy Policy

children.tpl: [[@rich:body]]

children.title: Privacy Policy
children.tpl: [[@text:title]]

children.title: How we handle your information on this website
children.tpl: [[@text:title]]

body.html: Plain answers about what we collect, why, and who sees it. For your health information, see our Notice of Privacy Practices.

children.tpl: [[@rich:body]]

content.tpl: [[@nodes:children]]

children.title: Who we are
children.tpl: [[@text:title]]

body.html: Ideal Dental Solutions is a dental practice with one office at 8280 Greensboro Drive, Unit 105, McLean, VA 22102. You can reach us at (703) 442-0442. This page explains how we handle the information you give us on this website, idealdentalsolutions.com.

children.tpl: [[@rich:body]]

content.tpl: [[@nodes:children]]

children.title: What we collect on this website
children.tpl: [[@text:title]]

body.html:
When you send us a form, such as an appointment request, we receive what you type in: your name, phone number, email address, your message, and the page you sent it from. Please do not put medical details or emergency information in a form. If it is urgent, call us at (703) 442-0442.

When you visit, standard tools also record simple visit information: which pages were read, the kind of device and browser, and roughly where in the world the visit came from. This does not include your name.

children.tpl: [[@rich:body]]

content.tpl: [[@nodes:children]]

children.title: How we use it
children.tpl: [[@text:title]]

body.html:
• To answer your message and book or confirm your visit.
  • To follow up on your request.
  • To understand which pages help patients, so we can improve the site.

We do not sell your information.

children.tpl: [[@rich:body]]

content.tpl: [[@nodes:children]]

children.title: Cookies and visit counters
children.tpl: [[@text:title]]

body.html: This site uses Google Analytics and a visit counter run by our marketing agency, TTR Digital Marketing, to count visits and see which pages are read. These tools can set cookies in your browser. You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings, and the site will still work.

children.tpl: [[@rich:body]]

content.tpl: [[@nodes:children]]

children.title: Who helps us run the site
children.tpl: [[@text:title]]

body.html: We use outside services to run this website and handle forms: web hosting, the system where our pages are written, the tool that delivers form messages to our team, and the analytics tools above. They get only what they need to do that job. We do not give your information to anyone to market to you.

children.tpl: [[@rich:body]]

content.tpl: [[@nodes:children]]

children.title: Your health information
children.tpl: [[@text:title]]

body.html: Information about your care as a patient is protected by the federal privacy rule known as HIPAA. How we use and share that information is described in our Notice of Privacy Practices (PDF). This website is not the place to send medical records. Please bring them to your visit or ask our team how to send them securely.

children.tpl: [[@rich:body]]

content.tpl: [[@nodes:children]]

children.title: Children
children.tpl: [[@text:title]]

body.html: This website is meant for adults. If you are a parent or guardian and think a child sent us information through a form, call us at (703) 442-0442 and we will remove it.

children.tpl: [[@rich:body]]

content.tpl: [[@nodes:children]]

children.title: Your choices
children.tpl: [[@text:title]]

body.html: You can ask us to show you, correct or delete the information you sent us through a form by calling (703) 442-0442 or visiting the office. If you no longer want messages from us, tell us and we will stop.

children.tpl: [[@rich:body]]

content.tpl: [[@nodes:children]]

children.title: Changes to this page
children.tpl: [[@text:title]]

body.html: If we change how this website handles information, we will update this page. It was last updated on October 28, 2026.

children.tpl: [[@rich:body]]

content.tpl: [[@nodes:children]]

children.title: Contact us
children.tpl: [[@text:title]]

body.html: Questions about this page? Call (703) 442-0442 or visit us at 8280 Greensboro Drive, Unit 105, McLean, VA 22102.

children.tpl: [[@rich:body]]

content.tpl: [[@nodes:children]]
